title: Configure Porkbun DNS for Fly.io
description: HUMAN REQUIRED: Login to Porkbun. Add A record: @ -> Fly IPv4. Add AAAA record: @ -> Fly IPv6. Add CNAME: www -> arxivbot.org. Run: fly certs check arxivbot.org and wait for Ready status. Test: curl https://arxivbot.org/health

title: Configure arxivbot.org domain on Fly.io
description: Run: fly certs create arxivbot.org && fly certs create www.arxivbot.org. Run: fly certs show arxivbot.org to get IPv4/IPv6 addresses. Save these for the next task (Porkbun DNS).

title: Create Justfile for deployment automation

close_reason: Created Justfile with dev, check, provision, deploy, verify, logs, ssh, domain, and domain-check commands

title: Deploy to Fly.io
description: Run: just provision (if first time). Then: fly secrets set GEMINI_API_KEY=<ask human>. Then: just deploy. Verify with just verify and curl https://arxivbot.fly.dev/health. HUMAN REQUIRED for API key.
